{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
[[File:Divvik_pupa.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Hologram/Legends|Hologram]] of a [[divvik]] pupa]]
{{Quote|I was such a promising pupa. Glassy-eyed, appendageless, able to move my organs around at will. The world was a titillating surface, an endless, glistening horizon that I had only to track across, to let slip under my underbelly, to feel satisfied. Ah, the simple joys of youth!|[[Unidentified Ithorian (Rimbaux Four)|An Ithorian]]|<ref name="MoaI">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/sourcearchive/news20070612.html|text=Musings of an Ithorian}}</ref>}}
'''Pupa''' (plural: '''pupae''')<ref name="ODStM">{{JournalCite|10|Only Droids Serve the Maker}}</ref> was a term used at least on [[Rimbaux Four]] to describe an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] youth prior to its metamorphosis.<ref name="MoaI" />
